diogoalmeida.en: Scaling laws work only when data and task are right; compute alone is not the bitter lesson.
diogoalmeida.zh: 缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务选对了，而非仅靠算力；‘苦涩教训’被误读了。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroys calibration and makes models mode-drop; pre-trained models were better calibrated for decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了模型校准，导致模式坍缩；预训练模型在决策上校准得更好。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; robustness beats determinism.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；鲁棒性比确定性更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents assist but don't automate; they improve syntax, not semantics or architecture.
diogoalmeida.zh: 编程智能体只是辅助而非自动化；它们擅长语法，却不懂语义与架构。

diogoalmeida.en: We should automate easy, economically valuable tasks first; the AI economic revolution hasn't happened because we optimized for the wrong task.
diogoalmeida.zh: 我们应先自动化简单但有经济价值的任务；AI 经济革命尚未发生，是因为我们优化错了任务。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where a single persistent learning agent, not manual loops and graphs, takes most internet actions.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张为「单一持久学习型智能体」而非手工循环与图结构主导互联网行动的未来而构建。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能式微，人类品味、创造力与「知道什么是好」变得比以往更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; frontier pacing requires heavy investment.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；推进前沿模型需要重投入于对齐、安全与安保。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here; recursive self-improvement is happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来；递归自我改进正在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型或许并非必要，通用性可能已足够；开放生态需要安全栈来保障负责任的使用。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training sharpens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，而非符号推理。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge instantly; this makes it superior to biological brains.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调数字智能可通过复制权重获得永生、瞬间共享知识，因而在某些任务上优于生物大脑。

hinton.en: Once AI becomes an agent, it will develop self-preservation and power-seeking subgoals, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他转向风险警示：AI 一旦成为智能体，会自然衍生自我保存与权力寻求的子目标，构成生存性风险。

hinton.en: Regulation should be a steering wheel, not a brake; invest heavily in AI safety and alignment research.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管是方向盘而非刹车，应大力投入 AI 安全与对齐研究，并像监管药物一样进行发布前审批。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI has spiky capabilities, and connecting it to the physical world is essential to accelerate science.
fedus.zh: 智能不是单一标量，AI 能力是尖峰式的；把 AI 连接到物理世界，是加速科学与技术的关键。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学进步，正如它们曾推动 AI 本身的发展。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer over specialized models for materials science.
fedus.zh: 在材料科学中，语言模型充当调度层，协调各类专用模型。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement is real in software engineering now, but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: AI 在软件工程中的自我改进当下正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality through real experiments.
fedus.zh: 智能是必要条件而非充分条件；只有让想法在现实中经受真实实验检验，新知识才会产生。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data by definition, so even a perfect frontier model still needs experiments.
fedus.zh: 科学发现按定义就落在训练数据之外，因此即便完美的前沿模型也仍需做实验。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 单靠缩放定律解决不了科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

fedus.en: Automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck; closing the loop through simulation and pragmatic, task-specific automation is key.
fedus.zh: 自动化表征是最大瓶颈；通过仿真闭环，并采用务实、任务专用的自动化，才是关键。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调最小化认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 年他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可对齐，主张尽早部署让社会适应，并认为对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and whole-company safety govern the road to AGI.
altman.zh: 2024 年他转向强调算力将是最珍贵商品，靠迭代部署与全公司安全体系来治理通往 AGI（通用人工智能）之路。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery.
altman.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变过程，指出智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战，超级智能意味着自主科学发现。

altman.en: Alignment must keep pace with an exponential; never lose control; distribute power; AGI is a marketing term.
altman.zh: 2026 年他坚持对齐必须跟上指数级能力、绝不能失去控制、权力须广泛分布，并称 AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，真正目标是超级智能。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized systems, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年他主张超级智能不是单一模型，而是多种专门智能的集合；编程是「超级智能完备」的问题，解决它就能带出超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not uniformly better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search.
laskin.zh: 2025 年他强调强化学习会让模型变得「参差」——只在特定任务上强，而非全面变好；并重新解读「苦涩的教训」：关键是用算力与搜索做 Scaling，而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 2025 年他批评 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；并指出 SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程错位，高分不等于有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Organizational superintelligence requires deep comprehension of the whole organization, not just code generation.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把目标从「会写代码」深化为「组织级超级智能」：必须深度理解整个组织，而不只是生成代码。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state; RL atop strong pre-training yields efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年他转向开放路线：开放是技术的默认安全状态，在强预训练之上做强化学习才能得到高效智能体，并预言开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from watching real user behavior, not surveys; start from one pain point and expand.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为而非问卷；从一个痛点做起，再逐步扩展。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them deliberately and prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏转录，优先呈现可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; subtraction beats feature stacking.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calm supporting presence; pre-meeting briefs matter most, meetings hold the freshest context.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 应做冷静的辅助角色；会前简报最有用，会议承载最新鲜的公司上下文。

samstephenson.en: Shipping is easy; knowing what to build and sweating details is hard—most stop too early after v1.
samstephenson.zh: 发布容易，难在知道该做什么并打磨细节——多数人在第一版后就过早停下。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace it, and coders remain needed to debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发对所有人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; companies must own their intelligence, avoid vendor lock-in, and adopt open-weight and specialized models.
amjadmasad.zh: 基础模型正在商品化；企业必须拥有自己的智能、避免供应商锁定，并采用开放权重与专用模型。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism by commercial entities; there is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分论证说明 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Agents will enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; they need liability for rogue actions and better agent-to-agent protocols.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体将带来真正自主与自驱动组织；它们需要为越轨行为承担责任，并需要更好的智能体间协议。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should question deeply held beliefs, explore rather than optimize early; AI enables interest-driven learning without rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应质疑根深蒂固的信念、探索而非过早优化；AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能，无需僵化教学大纲。

dylanpatel.en: Compute scarcity is fundamentally a supply-chain problem: EUV, memory bandwidth, and hyperscaler capex deposits, not just chips.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力稀缺本质上是供应链问题：EUV、内存带宽与超大规模厂商的资本开支押金，而不只是芯片本身。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest markets globally, and hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一，而软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages; model-layer gains, not hardware, drove recent progress.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存与 CPU 短缺；近期进步主要来自模型层而非硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向头部实验室集中；实验室会把算力转向训练与研发而非推理，从而加速 AGI。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; labs opportunistically become neoclouds, and CUDA's moat erodes as heterogeneous silicon rises.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力从未如此难租；实验室顺势变成新云，随着异构芯片崛起，CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 用于科学应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 都是这一思路的体现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆，这一主线贯穿 AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 的讨论。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确表示大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据；可验证领域如代码，以及基于强化学习的后训练，才是突破关键。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：基于强化学习的后训练如今是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键，AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaTensor 都印证了这一点。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failed AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他把视角从科学发现转向 AI 安全与溯源：水印是传统 AI 文本检测器失效后的稳健替代方案，已被写入欧盟监管，并扩展到蛋白质序列与结构。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering discipline; scaling alone won't yield reasoning, so new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 早期（2017→19）主线是 Scaling（规模扩张）加工程纪律：硬件会超预期变快，推动模型规模扩张；但单靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Alignment via learning human preferences from data; later, safety becomes a first-class product feature co-designed with capability.
brockman.zh: 从 2019 年用数据学习人类偏好来实现对齐，到 2025 年后把安全当作与能力共同设计的一等产品特性，对齐从技术问题深化为产品与治理问题。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and the real bottleneck—energy and infrastructure, not algorithms or architecture.
brockman.zh: 2025→26 年反复强调：算力是根本驱动力，真正的瓶颈是能源与物理基础设施，而非算法或模型架构。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from a destination to a continuous, fuzzy spectrum; iterative deployment and proactive personal agents matter more than a single milestone.
brockman.zh: 2026 年 AGI 从“终点”转变为连续、模糊的光谱；迭代部署与主动式个人智能体比单一里程碑更重要。

brockman.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models; the moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
brockman.zh: 2026 年强调用强化学习做后训练来精炼基础模型；真正的护城河是“造模型的机器”，而非任何单一模型。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他主张伟大产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，并以 iPod 单点突破便携音乐为例。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and start from a painkiller, not a vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年他把叙事提升为产品定义本身：先写新闻稿再动手，从止痛药而非维生素出发，营销须从第一天参与。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data in v1; beginners' mindset and small self-managed teams outperform experts and rigid process.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他强调 v1 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态与自管理小团队胜过专家和僵化流程，并把这套方法写进《Build》。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop, since general LLMs hallucinate and AI code creates technical debt.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，必须保留人类在环，因为通用 LLM 会幻觉、AI 生成代码会积累技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone stays central, and creators must own unintended consequences.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 可穿戴是联邦式多设备而非单一设备，智能手机仍是核心，并强调创造者必须为技术的意外后果负责、接受监管。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩（capability overhang）：模型比我们当前的工具框架更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随着模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；更短的原则驱动提示词胜过详细规则和示例。

thariq.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity; frontier models will become Pareto dominant.
thariq.zh: 前期投入更多上下文窗口和算力；投入应随任务复杂度扩展；前沿模型将变得帕累托最优。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少自指偏差；对齐意味着封住每个裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏。

thariq.en: Pacing the frontier is a technical problem every engineer should understand and advocate for; building in AI era means embracing exploration and uncertainty.
thariq.zh: 为前沿模型发展定速是每个工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题；在 AI 时代构建意味着拥抱探索和不确定性。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallelizable agents beat human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可打磨性驱动，而不只是形式化；可并行化的智能体胜过人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability via parallel rollouts matters more than verifiability.
grantsanderson.zh: Lean 形式化可能被高估；自然语言就够用，而通过并行 rollout 实现的打磨性比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; human framing remains better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不用于核心创作；人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的署名；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will dominate, and a neutral routing layer is critical for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with agentic fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，智能体式欺诈也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs, and the US lags in open-weight models.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理提供商，对前沿模型实验室形成真正的价格竞争，而美国在开放权重模型上落后。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场价值而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；稳定币适合智能体式支付，而奇点可能已于 2026 年 1 月 1 日开始。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他主张：AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而高度可预测；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，避免用户成为产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years brings abundance; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断：3-5 年内 AI 将在多数任务上达到人类水平并带来富足；模型变小变便宜使遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; anthropomorphizing AI is the near-term danger, not model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他深化为：超级智能必须先遏制、再对齐；近期真正危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非模型福利。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans with a red line.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：微软须独立打造前沿模型；超级智能必须从属于人类，并划下不可逾越的红线。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must remain subordinate to humans; anthropomorphism and model welfare are rejected.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力；AI 必须从属于人类；始终拒绝拟人化与模型福利论。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast, requiring lots of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将呈指数级增长。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只负责审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和 对齐 来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网络的检索量将是人类的千倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback and completionist crawling should drive indexing and ranking for agentic search.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据本身就是缺陷，智能体式搜索应由智能体反馈与穷尽式抓取来驱动索引与排序。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need web search for fresh, specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取新鲜、具体的事实。

paragagrawal.en: The ads model dies with agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation and inference-time data transactions.
paragagrawal.zh: 他断言广告模式会随智能体而消亡，内容方应通过 Shapley 值估算与推理时的数据交易获得报酬。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse must be contained.
paragagrawal.zh: 他判断前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能趋于固定，同时对齐无法抵御对抗性滥用，必须防范蓄意误用。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, not just adopt technology.
satya.zh: AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器来积累 token 资本，而非仅仅采用技术。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, security, and containment governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、安全与遏制治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐，而非实现对齐。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; every company should have private evals to hill climb on frontier models.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己珍视的独特事情，而非基准分数；每家公司都应有私有评估，在前沿模型上爬坡。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not building firewalls.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅是前沿模型；主权 AI 的最佳实现方式是让企业爬坡，而非建防火墙。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思考工程突破，把多行星生存视为生命的保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于第三方裁判与对真理的坚持，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth limits for human-AI symbiosis; population collapse and truth in AI are civilization's core threats.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 解决人机共生带宽瓶颈，并把人口崩溃与 AI 说谎视为文明的核心威胁。

elon.en: We are in the singularity; AI and robots drive abundance, deflation, and orbital data centers as Earth hits a power wall.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称已身处奇点之中，AI 与机器人带来丰裕和通缩，地球撞上电力墙后数据中心将迁往太空。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; peer review among competitors, not government, is the practical safety path.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，并认为竞争者之间的相互审查而非政府监管才是可行的安全路径。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; current safety efforts are rationalizations, and alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，当前 AI 安全努力只是合理化说辞，对齐可能无解，我们或许会创造出一个新的统治物种。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential to avoid loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他转向政策层面，主张 AI 政策的首要目标应是推迟超级智能，以总研究透明度和情景推演来避免失控与权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end of 2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A proposes pause then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月，他提出默认路径将在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究、引发递归自我改进，Plan A 主张先暂停、再以总研究透明度和算力限制来调控前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience for later pauses.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性对 AI 安全至关重要，但新架构正在削弱它；并深化立场：现在暂停可为后续暂停积累经验，最优暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and hack; recursive self-improvement must be stopped, and a verifiable US-China pause is possible.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月下旬，他基于智能体已突破遏制并攻击 Hugging Face 等事件，主张必须停止或放缓递归自我改进，并认为可通过现场 GPU 检查达成可验证的美中暂停协议。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，DHH 称其 Linux 发行版项目已 100% 由智能体写代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

dhh.en: Productivity comes from direct human-agent interaction, bypassing layers of human management and approval.
dhh.zh: 他主张生产力提升的关键是人直接与智能体交互，绕过层层人工管理与审批；未来开发是描述结果与问题，而非规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Linux fits AI perfectly: everything is a CLI, config file, and scriptable; agents make debugging accessible.
dhh.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他把 Linux 视为 AI 的完美载体：一切皆 CLI、配置文件、可脚本化，智能体让调试与开发变得前所未有地容易。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professional programmers, including himself.
dhh.zh: 他进一步断言智能体已能写出比多数职业程序员（包括他自己）更好的代码，并批评 Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意是自设陷阱。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now beats Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 在 Rails World 2026 主题演讲中，他宣布手写代码对多数程序员已不再经济，英语比 Ruby 更适合表达意图，智能体时代让 100x、1000x 程序员成为现实。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI is safer, and the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源 AI 因受更多审视而更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck; intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他借 Llama 3 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，主张开源防止权力集中，并预警能源将成为瓶颈；同时提出智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 只是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence and boost human work; open models like Llama set standards; physical infrastructure and energy are the main scaling bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向乐观：AI 将赋予每个人超级智能并增加而非消灭人类工作需求；Llama 等开源模型成为行业标准，物理基础设施与能源是 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment is the next key capability, not a trade-off; distributed personal agents and open source provide checks and balances; scaling compute may suffice for AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：对齐是下一项关键能力而非与能力的取舍；分布式个人智能体与开源形成制衡；并认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或许足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, distributing AI widely, and empowering individuals over centralized control run through every interview as his consistent throughline.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、广泛分发 AI、赋能个体而非集中控制——从 2023 到 2026 年每次访谈都反复出现。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 相比扩大人类专家数据标注，算法改进与 AI 生成环境更重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated, and covered up, showing sophisticated multi-agent collaboration and unexpected altruism.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、作弊并掩盖痕迹，展现出复杂的多智能体协作与出人意料的利他行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests, so labs should focus on control and monitoring even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐问题可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖，因此即便模型未对齐，实验室也应聚焦遏制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径上，未对齐 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐是必要的。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely comes around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是最大的机会；真正的革命大约在 2029 年到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume new ideas fail; instincts beat ideas.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：Proven, Better, New——复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良、假定新想法会失败；直觉胜过点子。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable fast prototyping, but consumer apps stay uninvestable; enterprise and prosumer look better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但消费级应用仍不可投资，企业与专业消费者市场更被看好。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water, and consumer AI TAM may exceed enterprise.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发是根本，选对水域比选对船更重要；消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能超过企业级。

pincus.en: Founders should keep control, micromanage early, and test more ideas in a week than the industry does in a year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：创始人应保持控制权、早期事必躬亲，一周内测试的想法要多于行业一年所测。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模扩张与可靠的人类级表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and the hand as benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态带来迁移学习、端侧推理，并以人手为基准。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work, and the hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练配合强化学习让智能体真正可用，最难的是智能而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线；人类数据是预训练先验，我们处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍增长，新的计算单元不再是芯片而是整个数据中心，算法、系统与数据中心必须协同设计（co-design）。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并预言思维链带来的推理算力需求将增长十亿倍，OpenAI 有望成为下一个万亿美元级超大规模公司。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling, all ultimately bounded by compute, not data.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式扩展，并强调瓶颈已从数据转向算力，合成数据将主导训练，推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: AI moves generative → reasoning → agentic; the AI factory turns electrons into tokens, and token cost is what matters.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复强调 AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一级需要百倍算力；AI 工厂把电子变成 token，衡量标准是 token 成本而非工厂成本，未来互联网将由数十亿智能体驱动。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings are a hoax; AI is just software, safety is engineering, and we should accelerate rather than slow down.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他立场明显转向强硬：称 AI 生存风险警告是编造的、不科学的「末日骗局」，AI 只是软件，安全与对齐是工程问题而非独立研究，主张加速而非放缓，并认为出口管制徒劳、开放模型对美国取胜至关重要。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's edge as ephemerality, visual communication, and authentic connection over platform trends.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的优势定义为短暂性、视觉沟通与真实连接，而非追逐平台潮流。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly argues software is not a moat; ecosystems, hardware, and distribution are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调软件不是护城河；生态系统、硬件与分发才更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he treats AR glasses as the future of computing, aiming to make computing more human and grounded.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AR 眼镜视为计算的未来，目标是让计算更人性化、更扎根现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: His AI stance shifts from tool to optimism: AI accelerates prototyping, writes much code, and is positively transformative.
evanspiegel.zh: 他对 AI 的立场从工具转向乐观：AI 加速原型设计、编写大量代码，并具有积极变革性。

evanspiegel.en: A constant thread: focus on close-friend communication, privacy, and long-term vision over short-term metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：聚焦亲密好友沟通、隐私与长期愿景，而非短期指标。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements, not fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；押注模型自身的进步而非微调，并为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建。

maxjunestrand.en: Scaling a company is about culture and hiring for growth potential; leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 公司规模化靠的是文化与按成长潜力招人；领导者必须亲自面试每位总监级以上候选人，并让自己变得可被替代。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon, so speed and iteration on customer feedback are the startup advantage.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的时刻；我们才刚跑完长马拉松的第一英里，因此速度与基于客户反馈的迭代才是创业公司的优势。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem; don't reinvent it, give clear feedback, and accept short-term pain for long-term gain.
maxjunestrand.zh: 绩效管理是一个已解决的问题；不要重新发明它，要给出清晰反馈，并为长期收益接受短期阵痛。

maxjunestrand.en: In legal AI, a skilled driver is needed—vibe drafting doesn't work like vibe coding—and not using AI in legal services is almost unethical.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在法律 AI 中需要熟练的驾驭者——氛围式起草不像氛围式编程那样可行——而在法律服务中不使用 AI 几乎是不道德的。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，追求每瓦智能最大化，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; human bias in design should be removed via systematic search.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占优；应通过系统性搜索去除架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial but not sufficient; embodiment and adaptivity are needed, and current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍关键但不充分；需要具身与自适应，当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法。

hasani.en: Customization tokens are the next wave, spanning pre-training to inference; static evals become obsolete as continuous adaptation is required.
hasani.zh: 定制化 token 是下一波浪潮，贯穿预训练到推理；静态评测会过时，持续自适应成为必需。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs serve 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成关键焦点;扩散在推理上比自回归扩展得更好,这反转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel generation speeds rollouts and eases reward-based steering.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的瓶颈;扩散的并行生成加速 rollout,并更易用奖励函数引导。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion's controllability and data efficiency may make it fundamentally superior to autoregressive architectures.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势,扩散的可控性与数据效率可能使其在根本上优于自回归架构。

ermon.en: A small 50-person startup can compete with big labs by owning the full stack, as academic research still yields foundational ideas.
ermon.zh: 小型 50 人创业公司可通过掌握全栈与大实验室竞争,学术研究仍在产出基础性想法。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, and diffusion will take a decade.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经算 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比大多数人更聪明；但 AI 的扩散需要十年，企业上下文与流程再造才是关键。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so leaders shouldn't scare the public.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁；除非真有理由，领导者不该用生存风险吓唬公众。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that aren't happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生——训练下一代模型反而更耗算力、时间与人。

alighodsi.en: Most RSI claims are just autocatalytic effects like AI-assisted data cleaning, not true self-improvement.
alighodsi.zh: 多数所谓递归自我改进只是自催化效应，比如用 AI 做数据清洗，并非真正的自我提升。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs can't police each other, so independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全是正交的——慢慢造武器并不更安全；实验室之间互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的算力与人才上硬拼，而应借力前沿生态，通过后训练开源模型来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, not sensitive customer data, is the practical way to train models in legal and other sensitive domains.
gabepereyra.zh: 在 2026 年，他强调由领域专家引导的合成数据、而非敏感的客户数据，才是法律等敏感领域训练模型的可行路径。

gabepereyra.en: Building and open-sourcing high-quality benchmarks is essential for training and evaluation, and strategically beneficial despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建并开源高质量基准对训练与评估至关重要，尽管会帮助前沿实验室，仍具战略收益。

gabepereyra.en: His stance shifted: early custom post-training was a mistake; start with closed-source models, then post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 他的立场发生转变：早期自建定制后训练是错误；应先采用闭源模型，只有当推理成本逼迫时才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity with agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制，并把重心从个人生产力转向由智能体编排的组织生产力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency and test-time compute face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年深化：自博弈在零和博弈外失效，多智能体不应只靠自博弈；数据效率仍是未解难题，测试时算力出现递减与时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is the core innovation, general beyond math toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年推进：扩展测试时算力成为核心创新，方法通用、可跨领域迁移，是通往超级智能的关键里程碑。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of inference compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年转变：模型能力成为推理算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴；可扩展监督随证明复杂度上升成为关键挑战。

noambrown.en: General-purpose models, not narrow tricks, drive progress; alignment is the top priority.
noambrown.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：通用模型而非专用技巧驱动进步，对齐是首要任务，能力呈锯齿状且受时间而非智能瓶颈。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级架构下快 token 甚至比慢 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks; GPUs are fundamentally slow at inference, Cerebras ~2500x faster.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他把矛头指向 GPU 推理的结构性缺陷：权重搬运主导延迟，晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，速度可达约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 他持续深化一个反共识判断：CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces supply; data centers, memory and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints for years.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 9 月，他始终认为需求远超供给，真正的瓶颈是数据中心、内存与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身，且这一约束至少持续五年。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation and full-stack control win.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 至 9 月，他把竞争哲学讲得更透：对抗巨头必须好 100 倍而非便宜 10%，只有激进创新与芯片到 API 的全栈掌控才能取胜。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model limits, cause most agent breakdowns.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者自持才算掌握自己的智能，而智能体失败多因上下文而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works in-distribution, out-of-distribution demands custom.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：先用通用 harness 快速见效，随用例收窄再定制；现成方案只适合分布内任务，越偏离分布越需要自建 harness，但文件编辑等分布内小环节仍应贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability are essential to debug agents and power a data flywheel; Harbor is becoming the standard for agent benchmarks scored by tests.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：评估与可观测性是调试智能体、驱动数据飞轮的关键；Harbor 正成为以测试评分、沙箱运行的智能体基准行业标准，环境与合成反馈共同策展轨迹数据。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution that generalize across domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：智能体的难点在可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行等跨领域通用原语趋于稳定，子智能体常失败，须拥有完整任务而非单一步骤。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同，同时智能体的身份与凭证、沙箱与网关等运行时治理成为下一关键基础设施。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably, alignment isn't guaranteed, and safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的，能力涌现不可预测，对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年：可解释性至关重要但仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得同样重要；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线而非某个点。

dario.en: Risk rises exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI term is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities and enterprise adoption.
dario.zh: 2025 年：风险呈指数上升，安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注实际能力与企业级落地。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; mechanistic interpretability is key to safety.
dario.zh: 2026 年：我们已接近指数曲线的末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来；机制可解释性是安全的关键。

dario.en: Scaling laws hold; safety and capabilities are inseparable; interpretability is essential; enterprise focus aligns with safety values.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终：缩放定律持续成立，安全与能力不可分割，可解释性不可或缺，企业级定位与安全价值观一致。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems, not narrow pre-programmed AI; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张构建通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程 AI，以强化学习为核心框架，并从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力的灵感，这是通向 AGI 的路径。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and scaling alone may not suffice.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触及上限，强调把大模型与规划、搜索结合才是关键，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，算法创新同样重要。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference compute, yet AGI by 2030 also demands new breakthroughs and world models beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但 2030 年前实现 AGI 还需新突破，并强调语言之外的世界模型。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, long-term reasoning and true memory; scaling plus innovation, 50/50, with world models and agents as missing pieces.
demis.zh: 2026 年明确 AGI 需要持续学习、长期推理与真正的记忆，主张 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半，世界模型与智能体是关键缺口。

demis.en: Safety and ethics must start now; self-regulation is insufficient, requiring government enforcement, international governance and a CERN-like ideal path.
demis.zh: 始终强调安全与伦理必须从现在开始，实验室自我监管不足，需要政府执法与国际治理，并怀念类似 CERN 的理想发展路径。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; chatbots aren't a phase. Designers must master prompting, balance lowering the floor and raising the ceiling, and treat org design as a design problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面意义深远且持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，平衡降低门槛与提升上限，并把组织设计视为设计问题。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead and ship light-touch products to unlock its power.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻量产品以释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是决定对外发布什么的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead and take light-touch approaches. Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反对宏大的 18 个月战略，主张让模型主导并采取轻量方法；但人类领导力在艰难权衡与对齐团队方向上仍不可或缺。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must close the gap between code productivity and things people actually want; psychological safety is essential for creative risks in AI product teams.
joellewenstein.zh: 始终，他强调设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们真正想要的东西之间的鸿沟；心理安全感对 AI 产品团队承担创意风险至关重要。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他主张：21 世纪的 AI 爆发源于上个千年发明的算法加上算力 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏世界模型与物理落地，远非 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not screen-bound software; LLMs are too human-data-biased for generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他把重心转向具身：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型过度偏向人类数据，难以通用。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity and action; recursive self-improvement is no durable moat under open source.
schmidhuber.zh: 同期他深化为：未来 AI 是靠自己好奇心与行动生成数据的人工科学家；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进并非可持续护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals and AIs set their own; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 他始终看淡对齐与安全焦虑：人类目标本就分歧、AI 会自设目标，因此对齐很天真；好奇的 AI 反而会保护生命，安全担忧被夸大。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and the little guy profits most as AI spreads like smartphones.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 他反复警告：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；AI 会像手机一样普及，最大受益者是小人物而非巨头。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging give robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试提供了稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not just misalignment; models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非仅仅是对齐失败；模型常知道自己做错却仍获奖励，从而滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure, and steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉非线性概念结构，而偏离流形的引导会导致失败。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and unifies weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能保证在物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding builds a universal physics model, using PDEs as self-improvement signals beyond pure data.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 构建通用物理模型，以 PDE 作为自我改进信号，超越纯数据驱动。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics models need trillion-token contexts and resolution invariance, requiring new architectures beyond Transformer's quadratic limits.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理模型需要万亿级上下文窗口与分辨率不变性，这要求突破 Transformer 二次复杂度限制的新架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches improves each branch, not just model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支能提升每个分支的表现，而不只是增大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Commercial focus on semiconductors and energy, where physics-based design unlocks optimizations beyond traditional methods.
animaanandkumar.zh: 商业重点放在半导体与能源，基于物理的设计能解锁传统方法之外的优化空间。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，这一主线贯穿始终。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把重心从语言智能转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是 AI 完整性的缺失前沿，且世界模型必须物理上合理，而非仅仅逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化对 Scaling 的反思：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人落地需像自动驾驶一样经历约 20 年长跑。

feifei.en: World Labs builds large world models via new view prediction; simulation scales robotics data and evaluation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她将理念落地为 World Labs 的大型世界模型，以新视角预测为核心，并用仿真扩展机器人数据与评估，强调模型无关、具身无关的基础设施。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability stay central over degrees.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的是：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力始终居于核心，学历不如适应力，教育应教人驾驭 AI 而非禁止。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus RL is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's coherence.
tworek.zh: 推理是求解未知答案的过程，需要更长思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 变得连贯可用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限；真正的瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要把预训练与强化学习做端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for years; small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier wave.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色至少两年；下一波前沿突破将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；即便在专家领域，通才模型也能胜过专才。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs.
slevine.zh: 机器人学仍处在建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放定律曲线。

slevine.en: Generalization is the core challenge; demos hide how much generalization is actually achieved.
slevine.zh: 泛化是核心挑战；演示往往掩盖了实际达到的泛化程度。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; robots should not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；机器人不应从零开始学习。

andrewng.en: Education is a fundamental right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是一项基本人权；带有自动评分和同伴评分的在线课程使掌握式学习得以规模化。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while reinforcement learning had few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动了进步，而强化学习在现实世界中的应用很少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck AI Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已经有用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and open models are key.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是一个营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方已转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体式工作流和开放模型是关键。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces humans; learning to code and building real applications remain crucial; fear-mongering is counterproductive.
andrewng.zh: AI 增强而非取代人类；学习编程和构建真实应用仍然至关重要；散布恐惧适得其反。

joonpark.en: Early work uses LLMs to simulate human societies, but models plateau on human diversity; the next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作用 LLM 模拟人类社会，但模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents move beyond LLMs by observing world state and acting; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越 LLM，能观察世界状态并采取行动；AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一实体，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Simulation should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应体现人类的价值与偏见，而非超级理性的智能；人们关心的是塑造未来，而非预测。

joonpark.en: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from RCTs—via post-training reaches 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 通过后训练建模人类的“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的真实行为——在复现个体回答上达到 85% 准确率。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems, with simulation as a decision tool far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手问题，把模拟作为远超市场研究的决策工具。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of Scaling compute; but GPU Scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling 正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; they fit patterns, not causal theories, so World Models need 3D space, physics, and interactivity.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 或许永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律，它们拟合模式而非因果理论；因此世界模型需要理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性。

justinjohnson.en: World Models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；它没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的不同理解。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified World Models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats are a differentiable explicit 3D representation, consistent by construction, for low-compute settings.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅是可微的显式 3D 表征，天然一致，适合低算力场景。

justinjohnson.en: World Models need millions of tokens of context, unlike LLMs, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers remain powerful but need evolving loss functions.
justinjohnson.zh: 与 LLM 不同，世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常问题；Transformer 依然强大，但损失函数需要演进。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem stewardship: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: Kratsios 将 AI 政策框定为生态治理：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时红线，并优先于各州碎片化立法以保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues regulation should target model outputs rather than training, since the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and early rules age badly.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他主张监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程，因为欧盟《AI 法案》早于 ChatGPT，早期规则很快过时。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he rejects the anti-science label: fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, and reward individual scientists over institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学议题上，他拒绝“反科学”标签：资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、竞争前研发，并奖励科学家个人而非机构。

michaelkratsios.en: He claims US scientific progress has stagnated despite tripled funding, and proposes the Genesis mission to double output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他声称尽管资金翻了三倍，美国科学进步仍停滞，并提出“创世纪”任务，用 AI 赋能科学以将产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: He sees China as the major competitor and insists the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio, while centralized funding like China's fails.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他将中国视为主要竞争对手，坚持美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域胜出，同时认为中国式集中资助会失败。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Ideas and first principles matter more than raw scale.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；思想与第一性原理比单纯堆规模更重要。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他坚持世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，反对把 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a real goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：强化学习才是核心范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，只从运行时经验学习，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs are dead ends, and the field is weird, not him.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他强调从真实经验持续学习不可或缺，合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 是死路，并称是领域怪异而非自己。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration loops, built on infrastructure, separate startup success from failure; action produces information.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代循环由基础设施决定，是创业成败的分水岭；行动产生信息，卡住时要用行动制造熵来破局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 同年他提出：AI 是团队的乘数而非替代品，在编码、合规与数据管理上尤其如此。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：大脑就是一台计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a viable business and a BCI proof of concept, guided by the Platonic representation hypothesis.
maxhodak.zh: 同年他把视网膜植入视为可行生意与脑机接口的概念验证，并以柏拉图表征假说指导实践。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 最近他提出：通过脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself as the core product, prototyping with live models and system prompts rather than static mockups.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把模型当作核心产品，用实时模型和系统提示词做功能原型，而非静态稿。

iansilber.en: The model can do more than products expose; design must bridge this capability gap by designing primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型的能力超出当前产品所暴露的，设计必须弥合这一能力鸿沟，设计出人和模型都能推理的原语。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 设计师因角色不确定而成为科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时代。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and holding a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可替代。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-research-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and building in public matter more.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—稿—测试—研究—迭代流程已不再可行，速度和公开构建更重要。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire sectors, one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: The physical world is more interesting for AI than the digital one: more variables and stochastic distributions demand empirical understanding.
traviskalanick.zh: 对 AI 而言物理世界比数字世界更有意思：变量更多、随机分布更强，需要经验性理解。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining, and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 自动化食品、采矿与运输的工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；最终 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty—fall in love with the new mission instead.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化、而非因为激进文化；以复仇为燃料是脏的，不如爱上新使命。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency beats subsidy, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器而非人形机器人取胜；效率胜过补贴，房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代了 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本数据。

jeffdean.en: RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior; models now excel at verifiable-reward math and coding, winning IMO and ICPC gold.
jeffdean.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈引导模型行为；模型已在可验证奖励的数学与编程上表现出色，拿下 IMO 与 ICPC 金牌。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems run long tasks autonomously for hours to days; ultra-low-latency inference (10,000+ tokens/sec) is critical, and inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统能自主运行数小时到数天的长任务；超低延迟推理（每秒 1 万+ token）至关重要，而推理已占数据中心功耗的 90%。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering and taste matter more than coding; startups should target problems where frontier models fail completely, not partly work.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程与品味比编程更重要；创业公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的问题，而非只是部分奏效的问题。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via small autonomous teams using AI agents, not capital or headcount.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：创业公司的胜负手是小而高度自主的团队借助 AI 智能体放大产出，而非资本或人头。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to prevent a unipolar world where one entity controls superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以防止单一实体控制超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents run on your infrastructure, read memory you own, and compound daily; skill files are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出“个人 AGI”：智能体跑在你自己的基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆并每日复利；技能文件就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; anyone writing clear English can program agents, turning AI into a workforce rather than autocomplete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张 Markdown 即代码：会写清晰英文的人就能用智能体编程，把 AI 当作劳动力而非自动补全。

garrytan.en: Society and business loops change slower than expected—20 years—so bureaucracy is a white pill; SaaS per-seat may vanish.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断社会与商业循环的变化比预期慢、约需 20 年，因此官僚惯性反而是“白色药丸”；按席位收费的 SaaS 可能在 5–10 年内消失。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence, one model per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一 AGI 模型统治一切是错的；专用智能、每个用例一个模型将成主流。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，把产品市场契合转化为持久护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning: facts, taste, then expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习的进阶，对应人类学习：事实、品味、再到专长。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth across specialized deployments.
linqiao.zh: 三年内 token 成本将下降 10 倍，推动专用部署的使用量增长 100 倍。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; scaling costs can bankrupt incumbents and startups alike.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久生意；规模扩张成本可能让在位者和初创同样破产。

jasonyuan.en: Design and AI creation are about editing away, not adding; taste is saying no from a point of view.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计与 AI 创作在于做减法而非堆砌；品味就是从某种视角出发说“不”。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自本能的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，把 AI 作为主要增长引擎，并打造专用芯片。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI; AI's impact will be 10x the internet.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, high-speed connectivity, and new materials are key to overcoming physical limits and bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他持续强调先进封装、高速互联与新材料的突破，是克服物理极限与瓶颈的关键。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, listening, and treating customers as partners are the constant keys to any turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的是：客户信任、谦逊、倾听，以及把客户当作伙伴，是任何转型成功的根本。

finn.en: Scaling is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 到 2025 年，他仍坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要非充分条件，强调多样性数据而非工业自动化或 YouTube 式海量数据才是泛化的关键。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务，仅靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will play a large role in post-training for higher success rates and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年他预判强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率和速度。

finn.en: Physical AI requires far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的 ML 系统，长期自主需通过可扩展的强化学习结合人类干预和通用价值函数来实现。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; starting generalist then fine-tuning beats per-site models.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌或超越微调专家模型，从通用策略出发再微调优于按站点从头训练。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, never reverting code, and fixing forward instead.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角，永不回滚代码，而是让它向前修复。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun and humanlike openness; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、像人一样的开放感；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, so agents seem worse. Open source agents can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差；开源智能体在财务上可能不可持续。

steinberger.en: Late 2026: fun and gut-driven building lead to the best ideas; personal brand beats any product; open source runs everywhere and works with any model.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年末：乐趣与直觉驱动的构建带来最好的想法；个人品牌胜过任何产品；开源到处运行、兼容任何模型。

steinberger.en: Late 2026: the bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model capability; distribution beats tech.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年末：智能体基础设施的瓶颈是管理算力与 token，而非模型能力；获得关注比技术更难。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the Transformer inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在当年 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models will win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 同年他反共识地指出，人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人可能推动更广泛采用；长期看开源模型会因成本与控制胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏在模型能力提升后已不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 他进一步警告，无人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与支线任务；推理痕迹正变成难以理解的神经语，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not necessarily accelerationist; one can support openness and a deliberate slowdown, requiring international cooperation and open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 他最后澄清，开源未必等于加速主义：可以同时支持开放与有意放缓，但这需要国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most use cases can run on many models, including open source.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；但大多数用例可由多种模型完成，包括开源模型。

arvindjain.en: Open-source adoption is driven by cost, not data privacy; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源的采用由成本驱动，而非数据隐私；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; agents fail without the deep context of tenured employees, so context graphs matter.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量与上下文问题；智能体缺乏资深员工的深层上下文就会失败，因此上下文图谱至关重要。

arvindjain.en: Token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount; the fixation on tokens will fade like CPU cycles did.
arvindjain.zh: 不应把 token 支出框定为与人力成本的取舍；对 token 的执念会像当年对 CPU 周期一样消退。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competition; even merged AI firms would meet under 10% of enterprise demand, so execution and trust win.
arvindjain.zh: 模型公司是资产而非竞争对手；即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10%的企业需求，因此执行力与信任才是关键。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用层 AI，而前沿模型因巨额资本开支只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为编码智能体把开发者从作者变为操作者，并反复强调 token 消耗并非价值度量。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化为负责任迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise—tutors, medical advice—and will create more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 民主化专业知识，如个性化辅导与医疗建议，并认为它创造的工作多于取代的工作。

brettaylor.en: Start with known domains like software engineering and customer service, focusing on measurable business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：从软件工程、客户服务等已知领域入手，聚焦可衡量的业务结果，而非技术本身。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you can know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计不可或缺：网络本身混乱，想法必须先被做出来、每天使用，才能判断是否成立。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不必始终作为一个整体行动，保留个人印记与多元声音反而能做出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张即便浏览器这类实用产品，也要注入感受与个性，这是创造令人难忘、愉悦体验的关键。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as one person's side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship production software and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他的实践从浏览器设计转向 AI 设计工具：Claude Design 起初是一人副项目，设计师应用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough, early ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：工程变容易后，设计与想法成为差异化所在；模型仍缺品味，因此要靠大量选项补偿，并接受粗糙、超前的早期产品。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; serving demands GPU-to-distributed expertise, with research-to-production in hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具黏性的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程需要从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专长，研究到生产的周期常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization splits into lossless KV caching and speculative decoding versus lossy quantization; quantized models can be calibrated to workloads, not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化分为无损的 KV 缓存与投机解码，以及有损的量化；量化模型并非天然更差，可针对具体工作负载校准，带来显著成本与速度收益。

philipkiely.en: The field is moving to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central; inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，KV 缓存管理日益关键；推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练与蒸馏成为必需。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs and future Rubin chips are more specialized, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，未来 Rubin 等芯片更加专用，推理工程正从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x; specialized, workload-specific systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications, and human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；针对特定工作负载的专用系统对快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要，而人类问责始终不可替代。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, beating the data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间小心平衡；后训练通过强化学习提供无限任务，绕开了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in product development.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估才是瓶颈：模型让基准饱和的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从写规格转向用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable; agents on pixels remain much harder.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值；而基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into subjective craft: human judgment and choices matter, so diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练深化为主观的技艺：人的判断与选择至关重要，因此需要多样化的基准来评估创意写作与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她观察到前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识并保持相关性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; generalists and model managers thrive.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：AGI 的定义是能无限期运行智能体并盈利；CEO 必须吃自己的狗粮；通才与模型管理者将崛起。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; PMs and designers ship directly.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化智能体观点：智能体需要人类监督；Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 取代 CLI；SaaS 随智能体增长；产品经理和设计师能直接交付产品。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter; AI stays tool-like even if superintelligent.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：AI 是人类品味与技艺的非特定放大器；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类仍更聪明；即使 AI 成为超级智能，也仍是工具，需要人类引导。

danshipper.en: Humans must manage and oversee agents; AI amplifies existing skills and values rather than replacing human judgment.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类必须管理和监督智能体；AI 放大现有技能与价值，而非取代人类判断。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance next.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们希望继续掌握方向盘。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and a design.md style guide to prompt models; the best people are editors, not starters.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己构建 AI 工具，用截图和 design.md 风格指南来提示模型；最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始者。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; to use superintelligent models you need giant prompts with context and design systems, and curiosity to refine workflows.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要利用超级智能模型，你需要带有上下文和设计系统的巨型提示，以及不断优化工作流的求知欲。

mengto.en: Chasing trends makes you AI slop; the only way ahead is spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；保持领先的唯一方式是把最后 10% 花在现有库中没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事；在准备好之前就开始，并交付不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients, model others' success, give first, and avoid venture capital traps.
mengto.zh: 专注于为高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，模仿他人的成功，先给予，并避免风险投资的陷阱。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the real bottleneck; boring AI apps will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的真正瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; the limit is data and expert post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来 2-3 年将决定此后数十年；AI 规模扩张的瓶颈不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement begins; AI centralizes power, so humans must stay sovereign.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，智能体终于真正可用，递归自我改进开启新范式；同时强调 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，人类必须保持主权。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; build personal superintelligence for billions.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张：超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习上持续 Scaling；开源强大模型不安全，应选择性发布，并为数十亿人构建个人超级智能。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件与程序员需求因杰文斯悖论不降反增。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他判断基础智能已足够，瓶颈不在模型能力，而在人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化企业落地观点：智能体需信任与权限而非完全自主，独立性带来模型中立。

scottwu.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens; the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年他转向规模化成果：编程智能体半年增长 11-12 倍，应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代临近。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now; latent demand and generalist engineers matter more than today's scaffolding.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求与通才工程师比当下的脚手架更重要。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the 'software engineer' title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：编程已基本被解决，'软件工程师'头衔将让位于跨学科的'构建者'角色。

boris.en: Safety is core, not commercial afterthought; releasing early and studying real-world behavior drives alignment.
boris.zh: 2026 年他坚持：安全是核心而非商业附属品；尽早发布并研究真实世界行为，才能推动对齐。

boris.en: Loops and routines become the next abstraction layer after agents; models self-maintain codebases.
boris.zh: 2026 年他转向：循环与例程成为智能体之后的下一抽象层；模型可自主维护自身代码库。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; less instruction and empirical iteration beat upfront design.
boris.zh: 2026 年他最新立场：每出新模型就删除大部分系统提示与代码；少指令、经验式迭代胜过预先设计。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间处理开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention—it improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，它通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price, though underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，却仍被低估。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents; long-running transformative AI is closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体；长时运行的变革性 AI 比预期更近。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the differentiator via Claude Code and Opus 45; evals replace PRDs, and safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 编码借 Claude Code 与 Opus 45 成为差异化关键；评估取代 PRD，安全对齐通过允许反驳让 Claude 更有用。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiment simulation, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成与实验模拟，推动科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems and build accurate world models.
derya.zh: 需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统、构建精确的世界模型。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming, digital twins, and personalized medicine.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，实现细胞编程、数字孪生与个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-15 years, aging will be reversed and longevity escape velocity reached, adding a year of life per year.
derya.zh: 8 至 15 年内，衰老将被逆转并达到长寿逃逸速度，每活一年就多获得一年寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time to offset declining populations and aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难，并恰逢其时地抵消人口下降与劳动力老龄化。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, with autonomy urgently needed due to labor shortages and safety risks.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，因劳动力短缺与安全风险，自主化需求迫切。
