qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates progress, while data collection and safety validation are the main bottlenecks.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据加速进步，而数据采集与安全验证是主要瓶颈。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are shifting from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy diffusion into existing machines over many years is harder than the technology itself; regulations always lag, and job displacement is less contentious in physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化在多年内扩散到现有机器比技术本身更难；监管总是滞后，而物理 AI 的岗位替代争议较小。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; every technology automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；每项技术都会自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位，这一过程反复出现。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳，真正的采用需要封装好的应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; its impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；其影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: The hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task; AI changes tasks rather than replacing professionals.
benedictevans.zh: 工作的难点在于上下文和判断，而非任务本身；AI 改变的是任务，而非取代专业人士。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天交付。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 当代码越来越便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委派出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的内部留存与打磨标准，为每个功能在发布前把关。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬性约束；系统提示缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; every output is a hallucination—some right, some wrong—with no 'smells' to signal error.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；每一次输出都是幻觉——有些对、有些错——且没有可察觉的“气味”来提示错误。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙与算力上限；进一步进展需要推理、搜索与模块化。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models; linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型可能胜过通用模型；语言学结构可能作为有用表征回归。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个用户或团队定制的众多个性化模型，相比 RAG 可大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot reach.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式召回与更深层组合。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the next paradigm, not scaling with more compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：用更少资源做更多事才是下一个范式，而非仅靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, with continual learning running on-device and users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再分化出多个专用智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: The web is hostile to agents; APIs often beat browser use for automation.
clairevo.zh: 网络对智能体充满敌意；在自动化中，API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体，建立严肃的事业。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not the technology.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正的护城河，而非技术本身。

clairevo.en: Human accountability still matters: you must own what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责仍然重要：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 大语言模型不擅长第一性原理的创造力，因此新颖想法必须由人类提供。

clairevo.en: Influence and charisma are the human skills AI cannot replace.
clairevo.zh: 影响力和魅力是 AI 无法替代的人类技能。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes; their failure modes mirror human ownership.
clairevo.zh: 智能体可以拥有结果；它们的失败模式与人类担责如出一辙。

clairevo.en: Bootstrapping lets you design a business that serves the life you want.
clairevo.zh: 自力更生让你设计出服务于理想生活的业务。

clairevo.en: A 100x multiple on happiness can outweigh a 10x multiple on revenue.
clairevo.zh: 幸福感的 100 倍回报可能胜过收入的 10 倍回报。

clairevo.en: Austin's balanced ecosystem may produce happier, more diverse founders than SF's monoculture.
clairevo.zh: 奥斯汀更平衡的生态可能比旧金山的单一文化孕育出更快乐、更多元的创始人。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and leaders should be asked directly for help.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他强调沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现，并鼓励直接向领导者求助。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他称 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，认为除缩放定律外还需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates collective progress and commoditizes complements, a strategic move rather than idealism.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他认为开源 Llama 等模型加速集体进步并商品化互补层，这是战略而非理想主义。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses evolve into AI glasses, enabling a post-phone future; adoption risk exceeds invention risk.
bosworth.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜，开启后手机时代，采用风险大于发明风险。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute growth drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; product and user value matter most.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立、算力增长驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束，产品与用户价值最重要。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、声音与专业判断反而更珍贵。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, ending back-and-forth chatbot co-intelligence and shifting the bottleneck from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，终结来回对话的共智能模式，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists: reasoning models closed math and logic gaps, yet weaknesses remain in long-form fiction and other complex tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 锯齿状前沿依然存在：推理模型补齐了数学与逻辑短板，但在长篇小说等复杂任务上仍有弱点。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—impressive, opaque, unverifiable—and this opacity is likely permanent, so organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd models.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——惊艳、不透明、难验证，且这种不透明可能永久存在，因此组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放定律是有限的；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally, not a finished AGI that knows everything.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的，而非一个无所不知的成品 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而非廉价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not AI capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人类路上的一个注脚，真正的瓶颈是监管而非 AI 能力。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, and authenticity means saying in public what you'd say to a friend.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限的形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实意味着在公开场合说出你对朋友说的话。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of intellectuals disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里全世界最好的老师；悲观听起来更高级，但往往是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; Silicon Valley cannot be replicated, and deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；硅谷无法被复制，威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder, though productivity gains on established codebases stay modest.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让人人都成为产品构建者，但对既有代码库的生产力提升仍然有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点至关重要；AI 产出只是起点，在设计调整上画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production as AI integration is only at its start.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产，而 AI 集成才刚刚开始。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering and a point of view produces average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死，反而比以往更重要；没有人类引导和观点的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Interaction will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking models is understudied, and design judgment is not correlated with adding IQ points to models.
dylanfield.zh: 交互将超越提示词；越狱模型研究不足，而设计判断力与给模型增加智商并不相关。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a nerd religion.
naval.zh: 2019 年时他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在我们有生之年不会到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，奇点论是极客的宗教。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound. Happiness is the absence of desire.
naval.zh: 2020 至 2025 年间，他始终强调财富来自持有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期的游戏才能复利；幸福是欲望的缺席。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents centralization. AI doomerism is overblown.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，反对过度监管，主张开源 AI 防止权力集中，认为 AI 末日论被夸大。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps. Superintelligence already exists in calculators; worry about unaligned humans.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用；超级智能在计算器上早已存在，真正该担心的是未对齐的人类。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; pure software is dying, the moat is hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型逼近前沿模型；纯软件正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users; PhD not required—obsession and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户；PhD 并非必需，热爱与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板，远未被解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration creates real value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标；编排与智能体框架创造真正商业价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' problem is cost, not safety; local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 电力是最大基础设施瓶颈；全天候智能体的难题是成本而非安全；本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward good questions; local AI counters big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励提出好问题；本地 AI 可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究；模型开始产出新知识。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief matter more than matching Meta dollar-for-dollar.
markchen.zh: 人才密度与使命信念比与 Meta 逐美元对拼更重要。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型阴谋等对齐挑战将成为关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；强化学习擅长数学、编程等客观领域，而非主观领域。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis as canonical benchmarks saturate; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 经典基准饱和使评估陷入危机；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

markchen.en: Models lack taste; human researchers remain needed for idea generation.
markchen.zh: 模型缺乏品味；想法生成仍需人类研究者。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for true understanding.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他强调深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是真正理解世界的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representational limits; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他判断单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征瓶颈，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与更好的世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样化采样，抽象与因果结构是分布外泛化的核心。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment is worsening with capability; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, demanding safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他警告对齐随能力提升反而恶化，哪怕 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，必须构建天生安全的 AI。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，超级智能应避开强化学习。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；并反共识地认为 GUI 比 TUI 更适合编程。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering, replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他强调 53 倍速的 Codex 带来实时交互与中途转向能力，让模型驱动动作取代确定性步骤。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他提出实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新的瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams must shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为产品团队必须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，并以品味驱动策展。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 在设计上仍然表现不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性。

ajambrosino.en: The design process is not dead but transformed: prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为设计流程并未消亡而是转型：原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他观察到角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage: documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为 PRD 没有死；媒介必须匹配阶段：文档用于澄清，原型用于测试。

ajambrosino.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based solely on model timing, not features.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出同一产品形态的成败可能仅取决于模型时机，而非功能本身。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being designed for developers.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他注意到 Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具取得了成功。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models that are better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出 AI 模型增加了代码复杂度；我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型。

ajambrosino.en: The best desktop app is a home base that connects to other tools, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AI in science narrows the hypothesis space and speeds experiments; it augments scientists rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 科学中的 AI 缩小假设空间、加速实验；它增强而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; perfect interpretability isn't needed for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not Scaling alone, drove its gains.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：驱动其进步的是专用架构，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 进步来自许多中等规模的胜利与十次错九次的试错，而非孤胆天才式的突破。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and prioritize strategy over UX polish.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎与迭代，产品团队应重策略与可理解性，而非只做界面打磨。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and agency remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的演进描述为从助手到协作者再到自主同事；小团队因此获得更大杠杆，但人类验证与用户能动性仍不可替代。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；真正的难点是删减功能而非堆叠功能，产品要避免生硬嫁接智能体能力。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, and multiplayer human-model collaboration is underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为，长周期任务委托配合验证闭环将重新定义生产力；模型应敢于反驳反馈，多人与多模型协作仍是被低估的方向。

mikekrieger.en: Curiosity, systems thinking, and preserving user agency are timeless; AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch.
mikekrieger.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：好奇心、系统思维与保护用户能动性永不过时；AI 应是思考伙伴而非拐杖，这一立场从 2025 年延续到 2026 年并不断深化。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via dogfooding, trust, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力靠吃自己的狗粮、信任与使命对齐；战情室需现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: May 2026: engineering bandwidth no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs yield to PRs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and just-in-time planning are key.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长心态与即时规划是关键。

fiona.en: Consistent thread: managers must dogfood the product, stay hands-on, and keep flat organizations to maintain pulse and agility.
fiona.zh: 贯穿始终：管理者必须吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，并维持扁平组织以掌握脉搏与敏捷。

fiona.en: Deepening: as agents handle more coding, verification and quality frameworks grow more important; role boundaries blur as PMs ship code.
fiona.zh: 深化：随着智能体承担更多编码，验证与质量框架愈发重要；PM 也能交付代码，角色边界模糊。

kolter.en: Supervised learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; unsupervised learning reconstructs inputs; evaluation requires train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把监督学习拆成假设类、损失函数与优化方法，无监督学习旨在重建输入，并强调用训练/验证/测试划分来避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety's core issue is unreliable specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型在固定数据上仍会提升，而安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规格。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化为安全不能只靠 Scaling，需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习让模型自我改进；可解释性可能靠 AI 智能体自动化研究实现。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已胜过人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，提示注入存在致命三要素，企业需要可配置的安全方案。

kolter.en: Architecture matters little; data and Scaling dominate; open-weight models are vital but need restrictions at high capability; AGI is decades away.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：架构不重要，数据与 Scaling 才是关键；开放权重模型对研究至关重要，但高能力时需限制；AGI 仍需数十年。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser substitute for data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未言明的需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代品。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他提出大自然是最好设计师，人是先感受后思考的生物，技术应放大而非剥离人性。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; art and sensory experience are medicine for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他深化观点：机器有传感器却没有感官系统，艺术与感官体验是疗愈身心的良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他转向领导力：创造力在约束下繁荣，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making intuitive, creative skills more valuable than rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他展望未来工作：人类创造力与 AI 结合，直觉与创造技能比僵化的五年计划更有价值。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划能力，强调 JEPA 和开源对 AGI 的重要性。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，认为下一次 AI 突破需要像 JEPA 这样的非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and objective-driven safety are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，未来在于具备分层规划和目标驱动安全的世界模型。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）与专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get alignment right.
murati.zh: 安全研究必须在公开环境中进行，而非闭门造车，才能做好对齐。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and continuous iterative deployment with public feedback.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并通过持续迭代部署与公众反馈来推进。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；AI 应成为思考的工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图与价值观至关重要；制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is essential: scaling informal models alone cannot reach sound math or superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不可或缺：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型，无法得到可靠的数学证明，也到不了超级智能。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement; verified generation improves sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 验证不是痛苦的合规要求，而是性能增益：经过验证的生成能提升样本效率与表现。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; grounding natural language in Lean is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；把自然语言锚定到 Lean 才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine needs prover, conjecturer and knowledge base woven by auto-formalization.
carinahong.zh: 自改进的推理引擎需要证明器、猜想器与知识库，并由自动形式化把它们编织在一起。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial; AI proofs may be ugly but can converge to human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 人类的品味与直觉依然关键；AI 的证明可能丑陋，但能收敛到类人的直觉。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但指出思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大提升。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling; distillation shifted focus from scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练规模扩张放缓源于部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力，而非技术极限，蒸馏技术将焦点从扩大规模转移。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities still lag text, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches; deep progress remains a key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出多模态能力仍落后于文本，模型像处理小图块一样顺序处理输入，深层进展仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization stays the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但存在锯齿边缘，需谨慎监督；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ shows generative products need fault-tolerant interfaces.
gustav.zh: 同年他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，AI DJ 说明生成式产品必须配上容错界面，产品逻辑要随之重写。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为类似智能手机的宏观迁移：真正收益来自重建基础设施，推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，而大公司当前受到的冲击被高估。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and gives users control over algorithms, not more addiction—a contrarian anti-engagement bet.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他进一步认为生成式 AI 让产品走向双向对话，并应把算法控制权交给用户而非让人更上瘾，这是一笔反共识的反参与度下注。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement; strong opinions loosely held, and good explanations—hard to vary—drive innovation.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：战略上追求“时间花得值”而非参与度指标，坚持“强烈观点、松散持有”，并相信难以被随意替换的好解释才是创新之源。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than bigger models; small open models can be performant and safe.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要，小型开源模型也能高效且安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with human-in-the-loop augmenting jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被视为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，人类在环增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and enterprise customization, and AGI as a single system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化与企业定制，并断言作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox provides safety and security.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱提供安全保障。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills are easy to create as markdown files, enabling hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能可以轻松创建为 markdown 文件，实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best used to handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们的理解。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts in Claude allow auto-refreshing dashboards; use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 中的实时工件允许自动刷新仪表板；对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，当你不完全清楚自己在问什么时使用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for; building custom hardware with Claude Code is accessible and cheap.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子们在 AI 方面表现出色，因为他们还没有学会不该问什么；使用 Claude Code 构建定制硬件既方便又便宜。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention to resist the status quo.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏；好奇心需要刻意坚持，才能抵抗现状。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together remains essential.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值，共处一室始终关键。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, joy and humanity are essential.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简洁是表达本质，快乐与人性不可或缺。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，创新应推动前进，而非为打破而打破；传统是保存火种，不是崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a deliberate risky bet; authenticity matters, so mimicking engine sounds would be fake.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，法拉利电动车是一次刻意的风险押注；真实性至关重要，模拟引擎声是虚假的。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics: batch size trades latency vs cost; memory bandwidth, not compute, bottlenecks long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦推理经济学：批大小是权衡延迟与成本的主要杠杆；长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 同年，他指出稀疏注意力机制能降低 KV 缓存内存成本但存在质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏率，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is a memory wall issue.
reinerpope.zh: 他反共识地提出，因推理成本，模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙，而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: AI chips: multiply-accumulate is the primitive; systolic arrays reduce data movement; data movement dominates compute costs even inside a chip.
reinerpope.zh: 在 AI 芯片上，他认为乘累加是基本原语；脉动阵列减少数据移动；数据移动成本在芯片内部也主导计算成本。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient due to quadratic scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 他反共识地指出，由于位宽与面积的二次缩放，低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; designers should trust intuition and start from solutions, not problem statements.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程已经过时，设计师应信任直觉、从解决方案而非问题陈述出发，流程本身从未真正产生伟大作品，是设计师的用心在起作用。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up 30-40% of time and must help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年初，他进一步宣称 AI 已让“研究—发散—收敛”的传统流程死亡，设计师画原型的时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，必须帮助工程师落地而非只交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not years; speed and shipping early build trust and iterate fast.
jennywen.zh: 同期，他强调设计视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月，通过快速发布、快速迭代和响应反馈来建立信任，北极星不再遥远。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年中，他提出 AI 时代的三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和没有旧流程包袱的“天才应届生”，并主张招聘后者。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not AI hype; designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity and exercising judgment.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把工作和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作；设计师的独特价值在于与模糊性共处并运用判断力，品味本身救不了设计师。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math that yields emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer, and scaling next-token prediction unlocks in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却涌现出意外行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，靠下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会解锁上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 缩放定律依旧干净；合成数据是未来，但必须保住熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，且认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with jagged intelligence, so keep them on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带锯齿智能的新操作系统，所以要给它拴上绳子。

karpathy.en: It's the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak supervision, and we're summoning ghosts, not building animals.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习是吸管式监督，我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物。

karpathy.en: I no longer type code, only direct agents; vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the bar, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 我不再写代码，只指挥智能体；氛围编程抬高下限，智能体式工程守住上限，思考可外包但理解不能。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are needed.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，需要算法创新和推理时算力，而非单纯扩大模型。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型能实现自主的智能体式行为，超越静态权重；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; superintelligence may first appear in narrow domains like science, not through general models alone.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未死，但需要指数级算力；超级智能可能首先出现在科学等狭窄领域，而非仅靠通用模型。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编程和数学之外潜力巨大。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities for scaling laws to hold.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是缩放定律继续成立的关键缺失能力。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact; openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术，并会因产业投入而持续；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，需要多层防护；开放开发对防止企业俘获至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x; on-policy preference data wins.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他将后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，指出数据质量比算法选择重要 10 倍，且同策略偏好数据优于离策略数据。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a recurring risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，推动推理与工具使用；同时警告过度优化风险，并强调开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models dominate due to strategic openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展；中国开放模型因战略开放而占据主导。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for the next decade of AI research, lagging closed frontier models by 6-9 months; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution, not a sudden singularity.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他预言开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月；AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然的超级智能。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是人类智能的关键、也是机器学习系统所缺失的；无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，从而实现更好的泛化。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity and sample efficiency.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励在现实任务中不切实际；用模型分歧作为内在奖励可实现可微分的好奇心，提升样本效率。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move beyond quasi-static tasks; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies enable dynamic motion and zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习必须超越准静态任务；神经动态策略与模块化运动策略能实现动态运动和对新形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real-world data can power any robot.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人学本质是数据问题；一个在多样数据上预训练、在真实世界数据上后训练的通用大脑，可以驱动任何机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出部署是首要的技术挑战而非单纯的商业问题；机器人无法像软件那样快速扩张，需要严格测试。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便无法确定模型的道德地位，也应善待模型；模型福祉部分重要，因为它影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in the system prompt counters over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；在系统提示中引入欧陆哲学，帮助模型避免过度经验主义。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, not deontology or consequentialism, shaping holistic character through training.
askell.zh: 这套宪法更接近德性伦理，而非义务论或后果论，通过训练塑造整体性的品格。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更大的判断空间；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳，反而损害判断力。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is pressing as systems grow stronger; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调系统越强，对齐越紧迫；同时能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准已落后于前沿模型。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research and autonomous agents working for days are major milestones requiring new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把自动化 AI 研究与能自主工作数日的智能体视为重大里程碑，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习共同实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，并主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升；最大社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make them interpretable today.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的堆栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让它们今天就可解释。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 纯摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, like AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法解决，而非新突破；完美的模拟器就等于解决了自动驾驶，如同 AlphaGo。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力和世界模型；无需先验训练数据即可实现 500 多座城市的零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality now matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 如今基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；内置传感器的量产车将在规模上超过 Robotaxi。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才推动真正的 AI 进步；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，没有单一模型能统治一切；每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo can be gamed and cause regression; sophisticated human evals remain the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准测试可被操纵并导致模型退化；精细的人类评估仍是黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: As AI hallucinates, human judgment matters more; in medicine, prioritize safety over accuracy and watch for omission.
edwinchen.zh: 当 AI 产生幻觉时，人类判断更为关键；在医学中应优先考虑安全而非准确，并警惕遗漏风险。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, start with simpler products, and build brand as the core of every decision, not an afterthought.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调创业公司先要活下来，从更简单的产品做起证明自己，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心，而非事后补丁。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software, with applied AI for consumers.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件艰难且利润最低，认为手机的未来在于生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件，并聚焦面向消费者的应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not a hype topic, and the word AI banned in product talks.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断 AI 模型正商品化并陷入价格战，主张 AI 只是提升实用性的原料而非炒作话题，甚至该在产品讨论中禁用“AI”一词。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous tech; make tech fun to inspire creativity, with efficient marketing arbitrage and community humility.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他认为在同质化的科技产品中设计是最快的差异化手段，使命是让科技有趣以激发人类创造力，同时靠营销套利与社区保持谦逊。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents acting after trust; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务；只有脑机接口能取代手机，而非眼镜。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties through real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 2025 年：模型即产品，必须像软件一样每日迭代，通过真实世界反馈发现涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年：聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows——界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年：安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and can take actions, amplifying human capability.
turley.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：愿景是个人化 AI 助手，了解你的目标、拥有上下文并能采取行动，放大人类能力。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年：下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富含可供性的产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具，并认为把一切输入都 token 化的通用智能体是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可以在不依赖昂贵强化学习的情况下训练智能体，机器人应像人一样从视频中学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; Africa is not behind but leapfrogs legacy gaps.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终主张 AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要，并进一步提出非洲并非落后，而是跨越了历史遗留问题。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注重心转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，认为这是当下最大挑战，且安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

nando.en: Language models can revolutionize education in local African languages; human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他深化到应用层面：语言模型能革新非洲本地语言的教育，而沟通等人文技能与编程同样重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment grounds AI knowledge and reduces hallucinations; it is on the critical path to AGI, not just robotics.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是 grounding AI 知识、减少幻觉的关键，且具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必经之路，而非仅服务于机器人。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector DBs as hard disk; RL is cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics: real-world data scarce; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调机器人领域的数据瓶颈：真实数据稀缺昂贵，通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据才是 Scaling（规模扩张）的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键，物理图灵测试（机器人清理乱屋）是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出 System 2（推理）进展顺利，但 System 1（低级控制）仍是具身 AI 最难的部分；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，家庭使用更晚。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, and fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升模型智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability not capability as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他转向强化学习：语言模型上的强化学习没有智力复杂度上限，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; coding is the leading indicator, and inference compute becomes a bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他深化这一主线：来自可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，而到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; RL is a new scaling axis, Transformers suffice for AGI, and long agentic coherence expands what models can do.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他进一步断言进展是指数级的：强化学习是与预训练并列的新缩放轴，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，更长的智能体式连贯性（如 30 小时）极大扩展模型能力。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration matters more than raw intelligence; compute is the new oil, and world models are not on the AGI path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他转向能力过剩论：编排工具比原始智能更重要，算力是新石油，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上，编程与 AI 研究才是直接路线。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反对在交互设计上创新，主张复用熟悉模式，并追求投入产出比，而非把每个界面都做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and designer empowerment matter more than perfection; ship fast and iterate.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终强调不惜一切代价追求速度：清晰决策与设计师赋权比完美更重要，快速发布、持续迭代。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清楚设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool, so invest in brand early.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具，因此要尽早投资品牌。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必解决常识，下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones; language remains the best medium for reasoning.
yejin.zh: 推理期算法与高质量合成数据能让更小模型追平大模型；语言仍是推理的最佳媒介。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是插值人类知识而非超越，AI 必须探索未知知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k, and random rewards can still help—open research is essential.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程：RLVR 可能损害 pass@k，随机奖励有时反而有效——开放研究至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; frontier models show homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 用多样合成数据与多元对齐的小语言模型可超越大模型；前沿模型反而呈现同质化。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner to jam with openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，开放地一起即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation and short cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需要与技术债一起迭代偿还，靠快速、粗糙的实验和短周期来实现。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy and AI enables real progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是可互操作的，代码即事实来源；90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留产物，AI 带来真正的进步。

nadchishtie.en: Entire functions (PM, research, sales) can collapse and merge in AI-first companies; design and engineering are two sides of one coin.
nadchishtie.zh: 在 AI 优先的公司里，整个职能（产品、研究、销售）可能坍缩并合并；设计与工程是同一枚硬币的两面。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small designer-engineer teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小型设计师-工程师团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能带来可预测的进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超过预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Frontier models struggle with bug finding and calibration; benchmarks are contaminated proxies that miss real coding messiness.
truell.zh: 2024 年他指出前沿模型在找 bug 和校准上表现不佳，基准测试被污染、只是糟糕的代理指标，无法反映真实编程的混乱情境。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他的立场深化为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人始终掌握主导权；品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor; the AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他转变了早期预期，承认自研定制模型已成为 Cursor 每个惊艳体验的关键；并判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，将历时数十年。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness matter as capabilities grow. The talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed. Evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究，并提出评估本质上比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved and compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队被解散且算力承诺未兑现，强调仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），第三方测试与监管势在必行。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes them smarter, but we don't understand their internals.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）更多算力和数据会让模型更聪明，但我们并不理解其内部机制。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is a killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; product managers often hinder development by not understanding the technology's generality.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但 LLM 的最佳应用往往不可预见；产品经理常因不理解技术的通用性而阻碍开发。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models should learn by taking actions in the world, not just passively observing data.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型应该通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而不仅仅是被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Modular, sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling; continual learning with independently trainable components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为模块化稀疏架构如专家混合能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）；用可独立训练的组件进行持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling will drive major progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展将推动重大进展，但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估了。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play and imitation learning give strong signal, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他认为机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈与模仿学习提供强信号，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major AI success; pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns transferable beyond language.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他持续强调通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是 AI 的重大成功；预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation or augmentation, not be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability to create real value; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他提出仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值；单一神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

abbeel.en: Curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments; human brain generality inspires AI, but current AI remains far less general.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他一贯认为好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败；人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 的通用性远不及人脑。
